name: Maple & Marsh Hostels
description: Budget hostels in 3 towns of the fictional Westwater region.

items.title: Dorm prices
items.content: Beds in 8-bed dorms cost $27 a night; private twins are $64. Lockers need a $5 deposit. Price list MMH-PRC-8.

items.title: Curfew-free access
items.content: There is no curfew; doors use key cards and reception is staffed 07:30 to 23:15. Guide MMH-ACC-1.

items.title: Volunteer staff rules
items.content: Volunteers work 21 hours a week for a free bed and breakfast; the coordinator is Tilde Johansen. Rules MMH-VOL-21.

items.title: Bed bug response
items.content: If bed bugs are reported, the room is sealed, the guest moved, and Pestaway is called within 6 hours. Procedure MMH-BB-6.

items.title: Bed bug outbreak at the Marsh Lane hostel
items.request_phrase: the Marsh Lane bed bug outbreak report
items.content: Since 2026-09-02 there have been 17 bed bug reports at the Marsh Lane hostel; 3 dorms are closed and treatment will cost $9,600. Report MMH-BB-0902-M.

items.title: Hostel sale plan
items.request_phrase: the plan to sell a hostel
items.content: The owners will sell the Westwater Quay hostel to Bunkly for $3.05M; the deal is due to close on 2027-04-15. Plan MMH-SALE-0415-B.
